parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH client_min AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(date_start) AS min_date
  FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_meta_ad_insights`
  WHERE date_start >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 37 MONTH)
  GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT c.client_id, c.slug, c.currency, CAST(cm.min_date AS STRING) AS min_date
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clients` c
JOIN client_min cm ON cm.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.has_meta = TRUE
